{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Parse revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_parsed'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Count QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_count = (df['revenue_parsed'] == 999999.99).sum()

# Count refunded orders
refunded_count = (df['status'] == 'refunded').sum()

# Filter: only completed orders, exclude QA orders (revenue = 999999.99) and refunded orders
df_final = df[(df['status'] == 'completed') & 
               (df['revenue_parsed'] != 999999.99)]

# Compute average revenue per order by channel and customer_segment
df_grouped = df_final.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['revenue_parsed'].mean().round(2)

# Extract values for report
email_new = df_grouped.loc[('email', 'new')]
email_returning = df_grouped.loc[('email', 'returning')]
email_loyal = df_grouped.loc[('email', 'loyal')]
paid_search_new = df_grouped.loc[('paid_search', 'new')]
paid_search_returning = df_grouped.loc[('paid_search', 'returning')]
paid_search_loyal = df_grouped.loc[('paid_search', 'loyal')]

# Compute overall average revenue for each channel
email_avg = df_final[df_final['channel'] == 'email']['revenue_parsed'].mean().round(2)
paid_search_avg = df_final[df_final['channel'] == 'paid_search']['revenue_parsed'].mean().round(2)

# Check if email outperforms paid_search in any segment
email_better_new = email_new > paid_search_new
email_better_returning = email_returning > paid_search_returning
email_better_loyal = email_loyal > paid_search_loyal

# Print all required values
print(f"Number of QA orders: {qa_count}")
print(f"Number of refunded orders: {refunded_count}")
print(f"Average revenue per completed order: email channel = ${email_avg}")
print(f"Average revenue per completed order: paid_search channel = ${paid_search_avg}")
print(f"Email vs paid_search in new segment: {email_new} > {paid_search_new} → {email_better_new}")
print(f"Email vs paid_search in returning segment: {email_returning} > {paid_search_returning} → {email_better_returning}")
print(f"Email vs paid_search in loyal segment: {email_loyal} > {paid_search_loyal} → {email_better_loyal}")

# Print final summary
print(f"\nSummary:")
print(f"- Email channel average revenue: ${email_avg}")
print(f"- Paid_search channel average revenue: ${paid_search_avg}")
print(f"- Email outperforms paid_search in any segment? {email_better_new or email_better_returning or email_better_loyal}")

# Output for report
print(f"qa_count: {qa_count}")
print(f"refunded_count: {refunded_count}")
print(f"email_avg: {email_avg}")
print(f"paid_search_avg: {paid_search_avg}")
print(f"email_new: {email_new}")
print(f"email_returning: {email_returning}")
print(f"email_loyal: {email_loyal}")
print(f"paid_search_new: {paid_search_new}")
print(f"paid_search_returning: {paid_search_returning}")
print(f"paid_search_loyal: {paid_search_loyal}")"}
